standard.summary: 放置成对图像的数据集目录。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The dataset directory holding the paired images.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 放置成对图像的数据集目录。当前版本先按固定分辨率读入，不走普通 LoRA 的子文件夹 repeat 语义。

advanced_en.principle: Dataset directory holding paired images. The current version reads them at a fixed resolution and does not use the subfolder-repeat semantics of ordinary LoRA training.
